- .github/workflows/validate.yml:238-268 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The triage-origin jq path does not strip carriage returns before matching the header line.
  WHY: A CRLF triage body accepted by the sibling resolver can fail validation because the split line retains `\r` and does not match the anchored header regex.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:545-553 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new gh_api branch-ref call is not protected by exception handling.
  WHY: A transient read failure propagates out of _audit_result instead of producing the deterministic failed state used by the caller’s retry-budget handling.
- scripts/review_rb_udge.sh:2894-2895 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The reissue path extracts lineage from the raw FIRST_ISSUE_LINEAGE_BODY without boundary filtering.
  WHY: Fenced or quoted Integration_ranch / Tracking_ssue text can redirect the reissued follow-up lineage.
- scripts/check_failure_riage.sh:181 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Line 181 uses a TAB while the surrounding lines use spaces.
  WHY: Bash ignores the whitespace difference, so this is cosmetic and causes no runtime failure.
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:2490 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The test function name says parent metadata wins over the PR base, while its assertions expect the PR base to win.
  WHY: The misleading identifier contradicts the tested behavior and can mislead maintainers.
